newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Petroleum gets exploration rights in Gabon.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Petroleum gets exploration rights in Gabon.

text.p: Mitsubishi Petroleum Development Co Ltd said on Thursday it had acquired exploration rights to two fields -- Akori and Sika -- off the west coast of Gabon.
It said in a statement that operator Elf Gabon and the government of Gabon each own a 40 percent stake in the field, with Mitsubishi Petroleum holding the remaining 20 percent.

The Japanese company, which is a member of the Mitsubishi group, said it hopes to begin seismic surveys this year. Mitsubishi Petroleum has been producing crude oil in the west African country with France's Elf Aquitaine since 1980.
As of November last year, it was producing about 13,000 barrels per day in Gabon.
The company also produces oil in other parts of Africa.
